comparison.objective: Candidate assembles rack hardware; record sorts cubes while yielding a shared bin to a person's hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests dexterous mechanical assembly; record tests collision-aware scheduling, pick-and-place, and human-space avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks installed rail mechanics; record awards per correctly sorted cube and irreversibly fails on bin or hand-proximity violations.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap in objective, physical skill, or success predicate. Candidate human-safety spacing is inapplicable, though its own robot/rack collision limits remain unstated.
